title: Rejection dedup latch in main.odin is the only untested branch logic in the feed path (feed-side counting is pinned; the tick||kind dedup condition is not)
evidence:
rnd.noc_feed_scan(&app.noc_feed, app.state.events[app.noc_mark:])
			app.noc_mark = len(app.state.events)
			if app.input.last_reject != .None && (app.input.reject_tick != app.noc_reject_tick || app.input.last_reject != app.noc_reject_kind) {
				rnd.noc_feed_reject(&app.noc_feed, app.input.last_reject)
				app.noc_reject_tick = app.input.reject_tick
				app.noc_reject_kind = app.input.last_reject
			}
detail: noc_feed_reject counting has a unit test, but the PP_DEBUG-gated latch deciding WHEN a reject is new (tick OR kind changed) has none — a regression double-counts or drops rejections in the panel. Dev-only readout, no sim impact.
recommended_fix: Extract the dedup predicate into the ungated feed (e.g. noc_feed_reject_once(f, kind, tick) -> bool) and pin same-tick/same-kind vs changed-kind transitions in noc_overlay_test.odin.

title: Panel scroll clamp and the noc_panel_rows/draw_noc_panel row-agreement invariant have no test (PP_DEBUG-gated, unreachable by gate-2 unit tests)
detail: The scroll viewport depends on a measure pass that MUST mirror draw_noc_panel row-for-row; nothing verifies the agreement or the clamp (noc_overlay.odin:435). A drift breaks wheel scrolling in the dev panel only.
recommended_fix: Ungate the pure measure procs (noc_panel_rows/noc_queue_rows/noc_pipe_rows take no raylib) and pin row counts for empty/full/sel_pipe fixtures against a draw-side row counter.

title: Rejection-kind label map (17 Edit_Error cases) untested — taxonomy label pins cover Drop_Reason + lanes but not the rejection labels
detail: noc_feed_taxonomy_labels pins E9/E22/?? and lane letters, but the rejection readout's kind labels sit inside the PP_DEBUG gate with no test; a mislabeled kind ships silently. Cosmetic, dev-panel only.
recommended_fix: Move noc_edit_error_label above the when #config(PP_DEBUG, false) gate (it is pure) and extend noc_feed_taxonomy_labels with the 17 kind->label expectations.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100%: 11 feed tests + 2 key-chain tests verified passing in the gate-2 (non-PP_DEBUG) config; gates 4/8/9/10 pin stream neutrality + gated compile. P1 ~90%: app glue partial (reject latch, scroll, e2e/sidecar manual-only per rulings). Overall >=80%.
recommended_fix: Gate is met; raising it further means covering the three note-level dev-glue gaps (reject-dedup latch, panel measure agreement, rejection-kind labels) by ungating the pure helpers.
